id: 631-第二次「星際大戰」（第三次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭）
theater: 佩滕東北納蘭霍與蒂卡爾

battle.name: 第二次「星際大戰」（第三次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭）
battle.theater: 佩滕東北納蘭霍與蒂卡爾
battle.brief: 公元631年，佩滕核心區再起星戰：納蘭霍與貝里斯河谷的卡拉科爾聯手攻入蒂卡爾，王雅什努恩·阿欣一世被俘，佩滕中心的舊秩序為之一空，此役即編年記所稱第三次卡拉科爾—納蘭霍戰爭。卡面的埃及月牙劍標示的是劈砍那一環：與它同源的是瑪雅那種鑲黑曜石刃、砍下不用拔的棍劍，正是破門毀碑時所用的東西。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場被當地編年記作第三次卡拉科爾—納蘭霍戰爭、也是第二次「星際大戰」的衝突，發生在公元631年的佩滕核心區，交戰的兩端分居低地兩翼。一端是貝里斯河谷「三石之地」卡拉科爾（Chak'ul）王國，它在雨林腹地建立起自己的王庭與勢力圈，首都卡安查克廣場上的三座石台是權力的標誌；另一端是佩滕東北部納蘭霍（Naranjo）王國，沿納蘭霍河踞守通往佩滕中心的門戶，並以連接納蘭霍與蒂卡爾的石砌堤道維持與南方的往來。兩城的聯姻網互相交錯：卡拉科爾王族曾以女子嫁入蒂卡爾王室，納蘭霍的君主也出自蒂卡爾王族的旁支，於是這場戰爭既是城邦對城邦的爭霸，也是家族內部的清算。佩滕中心的蒂卡爾（Tikal）是目標與戰場：它的王庭在第六世紀末的鼎盛之後陷入空位與權力真空，國王雅什努恩·阿欣一世被俘，此事記在蒂卡爾三十一號石碑上。納蘭霍一方並非孤軍作戰，戰前他們已在629年扶立由蒂卡爾王族女子與卡拉科爾聯姻所生的多斯皮拉斯，實際上就是把刀插在蒂卡爾背後的客戶城。
countriesEn: This clash, which the local annals count as the third Caracol-Naranjo war and the second 'star war', broke out in the Petén core in the year 631, with the two sides of the lowland holding opposite wings. On one side stood the kingdom of Caracol (Chak'ul), the 'place of three stones' in the Belize River valley, which had built its own court and sphere of influence deep inside the rainforest; the three stone platforms on the Caanchaak plaza in its capital marked the seat of its power. On the other stood the kingdom of Naranjo (Naranjo) in the northeast Petén, holding the approaches to the Petén core along the Naranjo river and keeping up traffic with the south by means of the stone causeway that joins Naranjo to Tikal. The marriage networks of the two cities overlapped: Caracol had given women of its royal house into the royal house of Tikal, and the ruler of Naranjo descended from a cadet branch of the same Tikal dynasty, so this war was both a contest between city-states and a settling of accounts inside a single family. Tikal, in the centre of the Petén, was both the prize and the battlefield: after its sixth-century apogee its court had fallen into an interregnum and a vacuum of power, and its ruler Yax Nuun Ahiin I was taken prisoner, an event inscribed on Stela 31 at Tikal. Naranjo was not acting alone: before the campaign it had already established Dos Pilas in 629, a client town founded by a woman of Tikal's royal line married into Caracol's house, which was in effect a knife planted behind Tikal's back.
people: 納蘭霍方面，統兵的是該城君主卡克·蒂利烏·昌·約帕阿特（K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat），他同時是蒂卡爾王室的姻親；一般認為是納蘭霍二十二號石碑的那塊立碑，記下他對外用兵、擒獲敵國君主的功業，這一戰是他政績中最重的一筆。卡拉科爾方面，王室的實際運作掌握在王室長房一系與長老手中，多斯皮拉斯即由卡拉科爾王族一手扶植；其後數十年，多斯皮拉斯君主努恩·烏卓爾·查克把這座客戶城變成獨立的出兵基地，說明卡拉科爾的遠征本錢從來不止佩滕一隅。戰敗方的蒂卡爾，掌國的是雅什努恩·阿欣一世，約在631年的星戰中被俘，蒂卡爾此後數十年王統中斷，直到西雅赫·昌·卡威爾一世與卡拉科爾出身的夫人卡巴爾·舒克所生的長子雅什努恩·阿欣二世成年，蒂卡爾才逐步重整。留下記錄的還有碑匠：蒂卡爾三十一號石碑立於744年，由西雅赫·昌·卡威爾二世主持，把292年、562年與631年的三次星戰刻在同一塊石上，這段記載因此是一份帶有王權事後立場的回溯，而不是戰場上的實錄。
peopleEn: On the Naranjo side the army was led by the city's ruler K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat, himself a kinsman by marriage of the Tikal dynasty; the stelae raised under his name (generally identified as Naranjo Stela 22) set out his campaigns and his capture of foreign rulers, and this war was the heaviest single entry among them. On the Caracol side the machinery of the realm ran through the queen mother and the senior house, and it was the Caracol royal line that had set Dos Pilas on its feet; within a few decades the Dos Pilas ruler Nuun Ujool Chaak had turned that client town into an independent base for campaigning, which shows that Caracol's resources for war had never been confined to the Petén. On the defeated side, Tikal was ruled by Yax Nuun Ahiin I, who was taken prisoner in the star war of 631; the crown of Tikal then remained vacant for decades, until Siyaj Chan K'awiil I and his son Yax Nuun Ahiin II, whose mother was the Caracol-born Lady K'ab'al Xook, had come of age and Tikal began to reassert itself. Those who left the record behind include the stone carver: Tikal Stela 31 was raised in the year 744 under Siyaj Chan K'awiil II, and it sets the star wars of 292, 562 and 631 on a single stone. What we have is therefore a retrospective account shaped by royal hindsight, not a report written in the camp.
kits: 卡面是埃及月牙劍（khopesh）。這件青銅時代的外彎單刃短劍並非戰場上的實物，它標示的是砍擊那一環的位置：外彎的刃口朝前，可以勾、可以劈，砍進去不必回抽。瑪雅方面血緣最接近的，是那種以硬木為柄、沿刃口鑲嵌黑曜石片的棍劍（macuahuitl，通稱馬卡納），同樣是單刃、同樣是劈下去不用回抽的邏輯；在佩滕的攻城與破廟場合，馬卡納與石斧（hacha）同樣用來砍倒守門人、砸碎石碑與祭壇。真正的骨幹兵器仍然是投矛器與燧石或黑曜石矛頭的長矛，另有短弓與箭、木製圓盾（tec'ah，框上綴羽）、棉甲（ik' te'）、投石索（húmat）與石彈、當作短刺用的黑曜石刃，以及佩滕特產的鋒利尾刺。糧秣是玉米餅、水葫蘆、鹽與柯巴脂，遠征按三日份計算，隊伍靠挑夫與獨木舟推進；佩滕低地雨林裡的行軍，本來就是一場以堤道、溪流與沼澤為節點的技術考驗。
kitsEn: The face of the card is the Egyptian khopesh. This Bronze Age short sword with a single outward-curving edge is not an object that stood on this battlefield; what it marks is the place of the cutting arm in the order of battle: the edge curves forward, so the weapon can hook and can chop, and once it bites it does not have to be drawn back. The closest blood relative on the Maya side is the club-sword (macuahuitl, better known as the macana) with a hardwood haft and obsidian blades set along the edge, which shares the same single-edged, chop-and-do-not-pull logic. In the siege and temple-breaking work of the Petén, macanas and stone axes (hacha) alike were used to cut down the men who guarded the gate and to smash stelae and altars. The true backbone of the armies remained the atlatl and the long spear with flint or obsidian points; there were also short bows and arrows, wooden round shields (tec'ah, with feathered frames), cotton armour (ik' te'), the sling (húmat) with stone shot, obsidian blades used as short stabbing tools, and the razor-sharp stingray spines for which the Petén was known. The ration was maize cakes, water gourds, salt and copal; a campaign was planned on three days' provisions, and the column advanced on porters and dugout canoes. Movement through the rainforest lowland of the Petén was in itself a technical exercise governed by causeways, streams and marshes.
tactics: 「星際大戰」（och bih）在瑪雅語境裡不是指星象，而是指以「星」為名的這種儀式性征服：由祭司依260日的卓爾金曆與365日的哈布曆定出出征日，戰前禁食、刺指放血、焚香，隊伍在晨星未隱時拔營。631年這一役的戰法，仍是瑪雅式的老套路：納蘭霍與卡拉科爾的聯軍沿納蘭霍至蒂卡爾的石砌堤道推進，堤道兩側是沼澤與淹水的低地，只有在旱季才通行得了；斥候先行，兩翼有樹林遮蔽，主力直到接近都城前才展開成密集隊形，以投矛器齊射壓制城頭守軍，再以棍劍與石斧破門、破壞神廟與石碑。攻入北台地之後，奪取國王本人是全戰的終點：國王被擒、石碑被毀、祭壇被推翻，這三件事同時完成，才算一場「星戰」；戰俘被押回本國，國王的血用於儀式，骨骼上架。歸程同樣屬於儀式：凱旋隊伍在城門前宣告勝利，戰報以石碑與舞臺的形式公開，反覆確認勝方的主權。
tacticsEn: In Maya usage a 'star war' (och bih) does not refer to the stars at all; it names a ritualised form of conquest: the day of departure was fixed by the priests from the 260-day Tzolk'in and the 365-day Haab', and before setting out the warriors fasted, pierced their tongues and hands to draw blood, and burned copal; the column marched while the morning star was still visible. The method used in 631 was still the old Maya pattern: the allied host of Naranjo and Caracol advanced along the stone causeway joining Naranjo to Tikal, with marsh and flooded lowland on both sides passable only in the dry season; scouts went ahead, the flanks were screened by forest, and the main body only deployed into a dense formation as it closed on the capital, where volleys from the atlatls pinned the defenders on the walls before macanas and stone axes opened the gates and broke the temples and stelae. Once the northern acropolis was taken, the capture of the ruler himself was the whole point of the campaign: king taken, stelae broken, altars thrown down - all three had to be accomplished for it to count as a star war. Captives were dragged home, the king's blood was used in the rites, and the bones were set up on a rack. The return was equally ceremonial: the victorious column proclaimed its success before the gate, and the result was published in stone and on the dance platform, over and over confirming the sovereignty of the winners.
data: 關於這場戰爭，可靠的數字極少，值得記下的首先是曆法與碑銘的硬資料。蒂卡爾三十一號石碑立於744年，其上並列292年、562年與631年三次星戰，說明從蒂卡爾上一次星戰到這一次相隔六十九年；星戰之日以260日卓爾金曆與365日哈布曆組成的52年曆輪標定，這是碑銘唯一能提供的時標，至於月序，只能按旱季行軍的常規推斷。地理尺度上，連接納蘭霍與蒂卡爾的石砌堤道近十公里，是當時兩城之間最短也最硬的一條交通線；蒂卡爾的北台地與大廣場區、卡拉科爾的卡安查克三石廣場、納蘭霍的聖山與主台，是三處決定性的攻城與立碑地點。兵員方面，碑刻並無可信的出征人數；學界對晚期古典期蒂卡爾常住人口的估計多落在數萬人量級，卡拉科爾的卡安查克聚落規模與之相去不遠，一支星戰遠征能投入的兵員，應以這些聚落中的專業戰士團為上限，而不是全城人口。
dataEn: Reliable numbers for this war are few, and what is worth setting down first are the hard data of calendar and stone. Tikal Stela 31 was raised in the year 744 and sets the star wars of 292, 562 and 631 side by side, which shows that sixty-nine years separate Tikal's previous star war from this one. The day of a star war was fixed by the 52-year Calendar Round built from the 260-day Tzolk'in and the 365-day Haab', and that is the only time marker the inscriptions supply; the month can only be inferred from the custom of campaigning in the dry season. In terms of geography, the stone causeway joining Naranjo to Tikal runs close to ten kilometres and was the shortest and hardest line of communication between the two cities at the time. The northern acropolis and great plaza of Tikal, the three-stone Caanchaak plaza of Caracol, and the sacred mountain and main platform of Naranjo are the three places where the siege and the raising of monuments were decided. On troops, the monuments preserve no credible count of men marched; estimates for the resident population of Tikal in the late Classic period mostly fall in the tens of thousands, and the size of the Caanchaak cluster at Caracol was of the same order, so the ceiling for a star war host would have been the professional warrior bodies of those settlements rather than the population of the cities.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外一層是地盤：佩滕核心的蒂卡爾在前一場星戰（562年）之後雖然受挫，王庭仍在，祭壇仍在，蒂卡爾的名字仍然是周邊各城效忠與繳納貢賦的對象；對納蘭霍而言，蒂卡爾的存在意味著北部諸城要向蒂卡爾進貢，對卡拉科爾而言，蒂卡爾意味著它在佩滕的客戶城多斯皮拉斯永遠只是一個代理人。第二層是家族：納蘭霍與卡拉科爾都與蒂卡爾王族有婚姻，631年的用兵同時清算的是血緣裡的舊帳——一位被推翻的蒂卡爾君主留下的空位，可以讓三方同時重新排列。第三層是儀式與政治：依瑪雅的政治觀念，一國若不能擒獲敵國君主，就無法證明對方臣服；「星戰」不只是一場攻城，而是一套合法性程序，由祭司定日、由君主執行、由碑刻存證。三層合起來，使631年的戰爭成為佩滕權力真空裡一次必然的出手。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. The outermost is territory. After the earlier star war of 562, Tikal had been checked, but its court still stood and its altars still stood, and the name of Tikal remained the address to which the surrounding cities sent their allegiance and their tribute. For Naranjo, Tikal's existence meant that the northern towns paid tribute to Tikal; for Caracol, Tikal meant that its client town of Dos Pilas could never be more than a proxy. The second layer is kinship: Naranjo and Caracol were both bound by marriage to the Tikal dynasty, and the campaign of 631 settled an old account inside the bloodline as well - the vacancy left by an overthrown Tikal ruler allowed all three parties to reorder themselves at once. The third layer is rite and politics. In Maya political thought a state that cannot seize a foreign ruler cannot demonstrate that ruler's submission, and the 'star war' is therefore not merely a siege but a procedure for legitimacy, dated by the priests, executed by the rulers, and preserved in stone. Taken together, the three layers made the war of 631 an inevitable move in a vacuum of power in the Petén.
impact: 直接後果是佩滕中心的天平傾斜。蒂卡爾的國王被擒，北台地的神像與石碑遭毀，蒂卡爾連續百年的紀年碑刻與大型營建中斷，王位空懸達數十年；直到七世紀末，蒂卡爾才在西雅赫·昌·卡威爾一世與其子雅什努恩·阿欣二世手上重新取得對周邊的支配力。更深一層，631年之後的佩滕不再是「蒂卡爾—卡拉科爾」兩極，而是三城並立：納蘭霍靠地理位置獨佔東北，卡拉科爾靠雨林深處的據點與客戶城獨佔西南，多斯皮拉斯則在兩者之間迅速膨脹，成為一把隨時可以插向蒂卡爾的刀。對周邊小城而言，這是壞消息：它們必須在三方之間不斷重選效忠對象，於是碑刻裡的進貢與被擒記錄急遽增加。以更長的視角看，631年之後的星戰愈打愈密，631、657、705，戰役從儀式性的襲擊變成對都城本身的重複打擊，佩滕再也沒有恢復第六世紀末那種壓倒性的均勢。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was a tipping of the balance at the centre of the Petén. The king of Tikal was taken, the images and stelae of the northern acropolis were broken, and a century-long run of dated monuments and major building at Tikal was interrupted, the throne standing empty for decades; only late in the seventh century did Tikal recover its hold over its neighbours under Siyaj Chan K'awiil I and his son Yax Nuun Ahiin II. A layer deeper, the Petén after 631 was no longer a two-pole world of Tikal and Caracol but a three-city one: Naranjo held the northeast outright on the strength of its geography, Caracol held the southwest through strongholds in the deep rainforest and through its client towns, and Dos Pilas swelled up between the two into a knife that could at any time be turned against Tikal. For the smaller towns this was bad news: they had to keep choosing an object of allegiance among three claimants, and the inscriptions accordingly fill up with records of tribute paid and of rulers captured. From a longer view, the star wars after 631 grow denser, and 631, 657 and 705 turn a ritual raid into a repeated assault on the capital itself; the Petén never again recovered the overwhelming equilibrium of the late sixth century.
result: 結果可以分三層講。戰場上，納蘭霍與卡拉科爾聯軍攻入蒂卡爾，蒂卡爾王雅什努恩·阿欣一世被俘，蒂卡爾的神廟與石碑遭毀，佩滕中心的舊秩序被砸開；這就是編年記所稱的第二次「星際大戰」，也是第三次卡拉科爾—納蘭霍戰爭。外交上，納蘭霍取得佩滕東北的實際控制，卡拉科爾坐實對佩滕中部與南部的影響，兩強由盟友變成競爭者，各自開始計算對方的戰力與產地；631年之後的636年第四次、680年第五次卡拉科爾—納蘭霍戰爭，說明這份帳並沒有因蒂卡爾的傾覆而結清。長期上，多斯皮拉斯在兩強的默許下坐大，最終在705年以自身的名義重演星戰，把蒂卡爾從二度傾覆的深谷中拖回來——這條反覆的路線說明，631年真正被改變的不是某一場戰役，而是佩滕那套以擒王為名的戰爭邏輯。
resultEn: The result can be told on three levels. On the field, the allied host of Naranjo and Caracol entered Tikal, the Tikal ruler Yax Nuun Ahiin I was taken prisoner, the temples and stelae of Tikal were broken, and the old order of the Petén centre was smashed open; this is what the annals call the second 'star war' and the third Caracol-Naranjo war. In diplomatic terms Naranjo gained effective control of the northeast Petén while Caracol confirmed its influence over the centre and the south of the lowland; the two powers turned from allies into rivals and each began to measure the other's fighting strength and resources, and the fourth Caracol-Naranjo war of 636 and the fifth of 680 after 631 show that this account was not settled by the fall of Tikal. In the long run Dos Pilas grew fat under the tacit consent of the two great powers and eventually, in 705, replayed the star war in its own name, dragging Tikal back out of the deep valley into which it had twice fallen. That repeated course shows that what really changed in 631 was not any single battle but the whole logic of war in the Petén, the logic of taking kings.
